hook_text: "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"
cliffhanger_text: "And you knew?"
"And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?"
Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

hook_text: "You have humiliated this family enough for one day."
cliffhanger_text: "And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!"

hook_text: "My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"
cliffhanger_text: "He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"

hook_text: "I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!"
cliffhanger_text: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

hook_text: Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.
cliffhanger_text: Alexander lunges across the room, tackling her to the wooden floor and covering her body entirely with his own.
"Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?"
"What? You want to fight us, veteran?"
"What wedding?"
"You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!"
"Who?!"
"I saved her! I healed her!"

hook_text: "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
cliffhanger_text: "Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"

hook_text: Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.
cliffhanger_text: Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.
"Her?!"
"Why are you doing this?"

hook_text: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
cliffhanger_text: "You still think you are better?!"

hook_text: "Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!"
cliffhanger_text: "What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?"
"My Lord?"
